name: EPIC 210746554

text.card: A red giant 1,702 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.47 solar masses and 13.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,589 K at its surface.
